noah: quick note: apac-edge NIC counters showing microbursts leading to packet drops on some hosts. impact: tail token retries and occasional runtime stall.
anya: did we correlate with batch sizes or NVLink activity?
noah: correlation to large NVLink memcpy and high batch_size (>128). seems hosts with heavy nvlink transfers starve NIC tx ring.
kelly: immediate workaround: enable nic tx coalesce and bump tx ring size for hot hosts. also consider affinity pinning so NVLink-heavy jobs avoid NIC-saturated nodes.
ops-bot: ticket NIC-487999 created. assigning to eng-infra-net.
noah: leaning to a scheduling rule: avoid colocating NVLink heavy tenants with high-egress tenants. maybe add a label on nodes with nvlink_pressure metric > 0.8
anya: scheduling label SGTM. also add a warmup test to detect nvlink-heavy jobs (sample first 5 requests for memcpy size).
kelly: will draft a small quickfix script to bump ring sizes and apply iptables qdisc for microbursts. low-risk.
noah: thanks. keeping to short updates.
